[SWS_CM_00038] E2E_check for method request provides Result with SMState and ProfileCheckStatus
⌈
In return, for the given E2E-protected Method
request, E2E_check shall provide a Result (e2eResult according to [PRS_E2E_-
00322] of [7]) containing the elements SMState (e2eState according to [PRS_E2E_-
00322] of [7]) and ProfileCheckStatus (e2eStatus according to [PRS_E2E_-
00322] of [7]).
⌋

[SWS_CM_00038] E2E_check for method request provides Result with SMState and ara::com::e2e::ComE2EErrc
⌈
In return, for the given E2E-protected Method request, E2E_check shall provide
a Result (e2eResult according to [PRS_E2E_00322] of [7]) containing the ele-
ments ara::com::e2e::SMState (e2eState according to [PRS_E2E_00322] of
[7]) and ara::com::e2e::ComE2EErrc (e2eStatus according to [PRS_E2E_-
00322] of [7] mapped to the ara::com::e2e::ComE2EErrc enum literal according
to [SWS_CM_12026]).
⌋
